blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **фы́ркнуть** — to snort, to sniff. Wiktionary: фы́ркать + -нуть.
**а́хнуть** — to exclaim, to gasp, to sigh. Wiktionary: а́хать + -нуть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to reproach, to upbraid, to blame
to click (to make a clicking sound)
to exclaim, to gasp, to sigh
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: упрекну́ть — to reproach, to upbraid, to blame; щёлкнуть — to click (to make a clicking sound); фы́ркнуть — to snort, to sniff; а́хнуть — to exclaim, to gasp, to sigh.
**то́пнуть** — to stomp, to stamp one's foot. Wiktionary: то́пать + -нуть.
